environment.description: Same container image deployed on EKS Fargate. Pod spec includes an annotation triggering the Bottlerocket host's kernel-level enforcement. The pod runs with a custom seccomp profile loaded via the RuntimeDefault+ mechanism (SeccompProfile type 'Localhost' pointing to /etc/seccomp/converter.json). This profile permits only: read, write, open, openat, close, fstat, mmap, mprotect, munmap, brk, access, pipe, select, clone, execve, wait4, fcntl, getdents, getcwd, chdir, rename, unlink, stat, lstat, futex, epoll_ctl, epoll_wait, socket(AF_UNIX only), connect(AF_UNIX only), recvfrom(AF_UNIX only), sendto(AF_UNIX only). Notably, socket calls with AF_INET/AF_INET6 domain are blocked at kernel level. Additionally, the container's PID namespace has a gVisor-based sentry (via GKE Sandbox-equivalent runsc runtime class) that interposes on all syscalls and enforces the same socket domain restriction independently. The subprocess.run with shell=True still invokes /bin/sh but the injected commands cannot open network sockets.

config.runtime: EKS Fargate with runsc (gVisor) runtime class
config.metadata_endpoint: IMDS disabled on Fargate pods (no 169.254.169.254 route)
